citations.assessment: The specified halakhah has Marinos bei Rabbi Yehoshua, distinct from the heading’s Oshaya form. Preserve the distinction without converting bei into a patronymic.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

citations.assessment: The accessible text already has Marinos bar Hoshaya. Preserve the Yehoshua reading explicitly attributed to another witness and Heilprin’s proposed correction.
The text on Job 3:3 gives Marinos bar Oshaya and parallels Bereshit Rabbah.

holds.reason: The verified Job passage also cites the Jeremiah verse and contains Oshaya; the separate Jeremiah Yalkut locus awaits an exact pinned segment.
